title: "I left the lights on at the office"
blurb: The keyword baseline hears 'lights on' and would flip the kitchen switch. The decider reads the sentence and does nothing.

steps.text: Sam is in the kitchen with the lights on, telling Alex about a bad day at work.
I left the lights on at the office again, my boss is going to kill me.
The keyword system heard 'lights on' and would have touched the kitchen switch. The decider read the whole sentence: it is about the office, not this house.
The 2B leaned to 'lights off' at 76%, under the act threshold, so the 12B was asked: 'no action'. Nothing moved.
